Source: In low-income countries, like Malawi, important public health measures including social distancing or a lockdown have been challenging to implement owing to socioeconomic constraints, leading to predictions that the COVID-19 pandemic would progress rapidly.
Luganda: Mu mawanga agakyakula nga Malawi, enkola z’ebyobulamu omuli okwewa amabanga oba omuggalo zibadde zisoomooza okuteeka mu nkola olw’okusoomooza mu byenfuna, ekireeseewo okuteebereza nti nawookeera wa COVID-19 ajja kusaasaana mu bwangu.
Yoruba: Ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ọ̀rọ̀-ajé kéré, ó nira láti mú àwọn odi pàtàkì fún ìlera gbogbogbò bí ìtakété síra ẹni tàbí ìsémọ́lé wá sí ìmúṣẹ láti ara àwọn òté tí ó jẹmọ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ajé ajẹmáwùjọ, èyí tí ó jásí àwọn àsọtẹ́lè pé àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19 yóò tẹ̀ síwájú kíákíá.
Zulu: Emazweni anabantu abahola kancane, njengeMalawi, izindlela ezibalulekile zezempilo zomphakathi okuhlanganisa nokuncishiswa komphakathi noma ukuvalwa kwezindawo kube yinselele ukuzisebenzisa ngenxa yezingqinamba zenhlalo-mnotho, okuholela ekuqaguleni ukuthi ubhubhane lwe-COVID-19 luzothuthuka ngokushesha.
Hausa: A cikin ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfi, kamar Malawi, mahimman matakan kiwon lafiyar jama'a ciki har da nisantar da jama'a ko kulle sun kasance ƙalubale don aiwatarwa saboda matsalolin al’ada da tattalin arziki, wanda ke haifar da hasashen cewa annobar ta COVID-19 za ta ci gaba cikin sauri.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tša letseno la fase, tša go swana le Malawi, magato a bohlokwa a maphelo a setšhaba go akaretša go tlogela sekgoba magareng ga batho goba kiletšo ya mesepelo a bile boima go a phethagatša ka lebaka la mathata a ekonomi ya setšhaba, gomme se se ile sa feletša ka gore leuba la COVID-19 le tla tšwela pele ka lebelo.
Amharic: እንደ ማላዊ ባሉ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ያላቸው ሃገሮች በማህበራዊ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ገደቦች ምክንያት ማህበራዊ ርቀትን መጠበቅ ወይም የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳን ጨምሮ አስፈላጊ የህዝብ ጤና እርምጃዎችን ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ፈታኝ ነበር፤ ይህም የኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ በፍጥነት ማደጉን ወደ መተንበይ ያመራል።

Source: However, due to limited capacity to test for severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection, there are no reliable estimates of the true burden of infection and death.
Luganda: Wabula, olw’ebbula ly’obusobozi bw’okukebera obulwadde obuleetebwa akawuka ka kolona-2 akakosa omussizo (SARS-CoV-2), tewali biteeberezo byesigika ku buzibu bw’omuwendo gw’abantu abakwatiddwa n’abafudde.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ipá láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìkóràn àpapọ̀ onírúnrú àìsàn àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn kòrónà ajẹ́mọ-èémí 2 (SARS-CoV-2), kò sí ìgbèdéke ìṣirò tí ó ṣeé gbẹ́mìí lé tí ó ṣòótọ́ nípa àjàgà ìkóràn àìsàn àti ikú.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yomthamo olinganiselwe wokuhlola ukutheleleka nge-acute acute respiratory syndrome 2 (SARS-CoV-2), azikho izilinganiso ezithembekile zomthwalo wangempela wokutheleleka nokufa.
Hausa: Ko yaya, saboda ƙayyadaddun iyawa don gwada kamuwa da cutar coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), babu ingantattun ƙididdiga na ainihin nauyin kamuwa da cuta da mutuwa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, ka lebaka la bokgoni bjo bo hlaelelago bja go dira diteko tša bolwetši bja phetetšo ya coronavirus 2 bjo bo kekilego bja go palediša go hema (SARS-CoV-2), ga go na le dikakanyo tše di tshephagalago tša morwalo wa mmakgonthe wa phetetšo le lehu.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ከባድ አጣዳፊ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ሲንድሮም ኮሮና ቫይረስ 2 (ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2) ኢንፌክሽንን የመመርመር አቅም ውስን በመሆኑ ትክክለኛ የኢንፌክሽን እና የሞት ጫና አስተማማኝ ግምቶች የሉም።

Source: We, therefore, conducted a SARS-CoV-2 serosurvey amongst health care workers (HCWs) in Blantyre city to estimate the cumulative incidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection in urban Malawi.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, twakuŋŋaanya olusaayisaayi mu basawo (HCWs) b’omu kibuga Blantyre era ne tulukebera okulaba oba nga lulimu akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 okusobola okuteebereza obweyolesi bw’obulwadde obuleetebwa akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 mu kibuga ky’omu ggwanga lya Malawi.
Yoruba: A wá ṣe àyẹ̀wò apa kòkòrò inú ara láàrin àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera (HCW) ní ìlú Blantyre láti ṣe gbèdéke ìṣirò àpapọ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkóràn àrùn SARS-CoV-2 ní ìgboro Malawi.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, senze ucwaningo lwe-SARS-CoV-2 phakathi kwabasebenzi bezempilo (HCWs) edolobheni laseBlantyre ukuze silinganisele izigameko zokutheleleka nge-SARS-CoV-2 edolobheni laseMalawi.
Hausa: Don haka, mun gudanar da binciken SARS-CoV-2 tsakanin ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya (HCWs) a cikin birnin Blantyre don kimanta yawan kamuwa da cutar SARS-CoV-2 a cikin biranen Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao, re dirile dinyakišišo ka ga boiphemelomalwetšing go SARS-CoV-2 go bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo (di-HCW) ka toropokgolong ya Blantyre go akanya tiragalo ya go gola ga phetetšo ya SARS-CoV-2 ka metsesetoropong ya Malawi.
Amharic: ስለዚህ በማላዊ ከተማ አካባቢ ያለውን የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ኢንፌክሽን ድምር ክስተት ለመገመት በብላንታየር ከተማ በጤና ጥበቃ ሰራተኞች (ጤ.ጥ.ሰ) መካከል የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ሴሮ ዳሰሳ ጥናት አካሂደናል።

Source: We recruited 500 otherwise asymptomatic HCWs from Blantyre City (Malawi) from 22nd May 2020 to 19th June 2020 and serum samples were collected from all participants.
Luganda: Twafuna HCWs 500 abatalina bubonero bwa bulwadde okuva mu kibuga Blantyre (Malawi) okuva nga 22 Ogwokutaano 2020 okutuusa nga 19 Ogwomukaaga 2020 era ne sampolo z’olusaayisaayi zaakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva ku beetabi bonna.
Yoruba: A gba àwọn HCW 500 tí ara gbé àìsàn pámọ́ láti ìlú Blantyre (Malawi) láti 22 oṣù karùn-ún dé 19 oṣù kẹfà ọdú 2020 wọ́n sì gba àpẹẹrẹ sẹ́rọ́mù fún àyẹ̀wò láti ara gbogbo olùkópa.

Hausa: Mun ɗauki 500 waɗanda ba su nuna alamar kamuwa ba HCWs daga Birnin Blantyre City (Malawi) daga 22 ga Mayu 2020 zuwa 19 ga Yuni 2020 kuma an tattara samfuran magani daga duk masu shiga binciken.
Northern Sotho: Re ngwadišitše di-HCW tše 500 tšeo di bego di se na maswao a bolwetši go tšwa ka Toropokgolong ya Blantyre (Malawi) go thoma ka la 22 Mei 2020 go fihla ka la 19 June 2020 gomme disampole tša seramo di kgobokeditšwe go bakgathatema ka moka.
Amharic: ከሜይ 22 2020 እስከ ጁን 19 2020 500 የበሽታ ምልክት የማያሳዩ የጤ.ጥ.ሰ ከብላንታየር ከተማ (ማላዊ) መልምለን የሴረም ናሙናዎችን ከሁሉም ሰብስበናል።

Hausa: Yin amfani da ƙididdigar yawan kamuwa da cutar da aka ruwaito daga wasu wurare, mun gano cewa a daidaitaccen yanayin da aka lura, adadin mutuwar da aka yi hasashen ya ninka adadin mutuwar da aka ruwaito sau takwas.
